plan.failureSummary: Deterministic cached step failed to locate element '[data-testid=\'radio-age-25-34\']' on the survey page due to a form layout change (Set 2).
observedIndicators: Tool call 'click' failed with 'Unable to resolve HTML element to operate with' for selector '[data-testid=\'radio-age-25-34\']'
Failure screenshot shows form header badge 'Set 2' with Occupation and Interests fields instead of age radio buttons
Run mode was DETERMINISTIC, relying on cached selectors from a previous run (Set 1 layout)
Test code itself uses flexible page.ai() prompt rather than hardcoded Playwright locators

remediationSteps.summary: Clear PageAI cache and retry test execution
remediationSteps.details: Clear the PageAI cache for unstable-survey.test.ts to purge stale cached steps and re-run the test autonomously.

remediationSteps.summary: Account for dynamic question sets in survey flow
remediationSteps.details: If the survey application dynamically switches form sets ('Set 1' vs 'Set 2'), consider configuring PageAI cache invalidation strategies or running in full autonomous mode.

plan.notes: The test uses high-level autonomous page.ai() calls. During deterministic re-execution, Donobu attempted to reuse cached selectors for age radio buttons ('[data-testid=\'radio-age-25-34\']'). However, the live screenshot shows the survey rendered 'Set 2' with different input fields (Occupation, Interests) and no age radio button. Clearing the PageAI cache will force autonomous reasoning to interact with the current dynamic form layout.
